name: ORB 5 with order flow: break taken only when RTH aggressor flow agrees
why: A range break that aggressive buyers (sellers) are driving — net market orders since the open on the break's side — is real demand exhausting the other side's resting orders; a break against the flow is a stop run that resting liquidity absorbs and reverses. (development copy for the 2026-10-16 pre-registered tests 1 and 5: data to 2026-03-19)

scan.when: flow && cvol > 0 && (cl(1,1) > rhi(5) || cl(1,1) < rlo(5)) && ((cl(1,1) > rhi(5)) - (cl(1,1) < rlo(5))) * cdelta > f * cvol
